visible_observation: The schedule grid relies on thin, low-contrast vertical lines to separate the three stages, while the time labels (12:00 PM, 2:00 PM, etc.) are placed in the left margin with low contrast against the dark background. The individual performance cards are small, dark rectangles with small text, creating a dense visual texture.
critique: The vertical separation between stages is too subtle, forcing the eye to work to distinguish columns. The low-contrast time labels and dark card backgrounds create visual noise, making it difficult to scan the schedule chronologically at a glance. The design prioritizes a 'dark mode' aesthetic over the legibility of the data grid.
revision: Increase the contrast of the vertical grid lines (make them brighter or thicker) to clearly define the stage columns. Lighten the background of the performance cards or increase the text size to improve readability and reduce visual density.
protected_strength: The horizontal banding of the headliner at the bottom effectively anchors the page and provides a clear visual hierarchy without disrupting the grid structure.
